description: Inputs passed to the Pharos stablecoin safe-mode policy WASM at evaluation time

stablecoin_id.description: Canonical Pharos stablecoin identifier in ticker-issuer form, e.g. 'usdc-circle'.

stress_lookback_days.description: Lookback window in days for the Pharos stress-signal history. Defaults to 7.

flow_window_hours.description: Window in hours for the mint/burn flow-anomaly lookup. Defaults to 24.
